theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Eligible, rank #2 just below the AI-infra leader, and it carries the cleanest trend leg: hurst_tag='trend' (the only path with remembered/trending behavior), durability_bar 0.72, breadth 0.75, uncrowded (crowding_z 0.15). While momentum rank is not a forecast, the trend-gate eligibility plus genuine breadth means leadership is broad enough to be a candidate for trend-following continuation rather than an attention spike.

theses.subject: Non-AI Tech & Hardware
theses.thesis: Eligible with the single strongest durability_bar in the whole tape (0.9), perfect breadth (1.0), hurst_tag='trend', and uncrowded (0.97 z). This is the most cohesive trend-health read available: nearly every underlying name participating at once is the condition where trend-following discipline (not forecasting) historically avoids the shaking-out of weak hands.
theses.dissent: This is largely the non-AI residue of the same tech complex — if the AI trade unwinds broadly, 'non-AI' hardware offers no diversification and may just be late participation in the same liquidity event.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The headline/leader (rank 1, breadth 0.875) and still eligible under the trend gate, uncrowded (crowding_z 0.84), with a large margin over the challenger (0.422). Leadership is broad and not crowded, so it is a stay-with-the-leader lean rather than a fade — but note durability_bar is only 0.71 and hurst is mixed, so this is the lower-conviction name among eligible trends.
evidence: headline.one_narrative: false (not a single narrative squeeze)
theses.dissent: AI-infra has led for a long time and momentum rank has no forward edge; the wide margin to the challenger can compress quickly, and 'mixed' hurst means the trend has already lost some internal order.
